Firefox/Mozilla user preferences configuration file containing browser settings and state data persisted across sessions.

## Key Components

| Preference Key | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `app.normandy.first_run` | Tracks whether the Normandy experimentation system has run for the first time |
| `app.normandy.migrationsApplied` | Records the number of Normandy schema migrations completed |
| `app.normandy.user_id` | Unique UUID identifying this Firefox profile for telemetry/experiments |
| `app.update.background.previous.reasons` | Logs reasons why background updates failed (e.g., missing maintenance service registry key) |
| `browser.contextual-services.contextId` | UUID used to associate contextual recommendations with this browser session |
| `browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.discoverystream.rec.impressions` | Timestamps of article recommendation impressions shown on the new tab page |
| `browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.discoverystream.spoc.impressions` | Timestamps of sponsored content impressions shown on the new tab page |
| `browser.newtabpage.pinned` | JSON array of pinned shortcuts on the Firefox new tab page |

## Usage Example

> ⚠️ **Do not edit this file directly while Firefox is running** — changes will be overwritten on exit.

To override a preference, add it to your `user.js` profile file:

```javascript
// ~/.mozilla/firefox/<profile>/user.js

// Disable Normandy experiments
user_pref("app.normandy.first_run", false);

// Clear pinned new tab sites
user_pref("browser.newtabpage.pinned", "[]");
```

Alternatively, navigate to `about:config` in the Firefox address bar and search for the preference key to modify it through the UI.

> **Note:** This file is auto-generated by Firefox and represents a snapshot of browser state — UUIDs and impression timestamps are unique per installation.
